thesis.statement: Helios can become the system of control for volatile enterprise GPU spend if ordinary cohorts retain and optimizer savings translate into durable platform economics.

value_creation.dependency: HX-02 ordinary-cohort definition and referenceable non-design-partner renewal evidence
value_creation.milestone: Cohort playbooks and referenceable renewal evidence by quarter 2
value_creation.stop_rule: Stop expansion credit if two ordinary cohorts fall below 105% NRR.
value_creation.value: Formula: ordinary ARR × NRR gap × gross margin × 50% realization; $0.08M monthly cash and $9.06M exit-equity scenario credit

value_creation.dependency: HX-06 synthetic randomized test plus a production replication tied to provider invoices
value_creation.milestone: Replicate randomized log-cost effect in production before tranche test
value_creation.risk: Provider price changes or workload mix invalidate transferred savings
value_creation.stop_rule: Stop optimizer credit if the production replication interval crosses zero.
value_creation.value: Formula: LTM compute cost × (1 − exp(log-point ITT)) × 65% adoption; $0.05M monthly cash and $7.73M exit-equity scenario credit

value_creation.dependency: HX-04 complete stage-history audit and a governed CRM stage dictionary
value_creation.milestone: Opportunity-level stage audit and forecast council by day 45
value_creation.stop_rule: Keep the tranche withheld when stage history is incomplete or forecast error remains at or above 15%.
value_creation.value: Avoids an illustrative shortfall-round trigger; unidentified forecast effect receives zero base-case credit

economic_mapping.formula: ordinary_base_arr_cents * max(0, target_nrr - observed_nrr) * gross_margin * 50% realization

economic_mapping.causal_boundary: Synthetic ITT identifies the planted test population only; adoption and valuation multiple remain scenario judgments.
